raw_evidence_sections.heading: Admission requirements & application
raw_evidence_sections.text: Funding This makes the Master in Finance special The financial industry is one of the most important sectors of the economy. It is also an industry with a particular need for values and a responsibility towards people. At EBS Universität, we offer you state-of-the-art teaching content, individual personal development and practical work with the big names from the finance industry. So you are perfectly prepared for an exciting future. Welcome to the EBS family. The most important part of your studies is not only 'what', but especially 'with whom'. The EBS family is an exceptional community. International, inspiring, innovative. You are not studying with strangers but with friends, with like-minded people. We want to achieve remarkable things together. Our students organise congresses, cultural events or run their own real investment fund. Knowledge has no value without values. We know just how important it is, especially in business management, to work with diverse stakeholders, i.e. other people, so that empathy and values make the decisive difference. They shape future leaders who drive things forward and engage others. We teach our values courage, responsibility, consideration and a strong backbone in our classes and our Coaching & Leadership Hub. Challenge-based learning with state-of-the-art content: Studying at EBS must keep up with the pace of the international financial markets. Blockchain, AI, Roboadvisory or FinTech are part of everyday life at EBS.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: With the Accelerated Track , you have the opportunity to shorten the duration of your studies and complete your Master's degree programme in two semesters (60 E
raw_evidence_sections.text: During your studies, you will acquire key competences for your future job in Professional Development Workshops and will be prepared for a career as a leadership personality through individual coaching from the EBS Coaching & Leadership Hub . In addition, you will have the opportunity to further develop your international language skills through foreign language courses at the EBS Language Centre . This is what you learn in the Master in Finance The Master in Finance programme teaches General Content, which helps you to place subject knowledge in a wider context, and then goes further and further in depth with Advanced Content to build expertise in the relevant subject area.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Accelerate your career. The Accelerated Track gives you the opportunity to shorten the duration of your studies to two semesters. The prerequisite for this trac
raw_evidence_sections.text: Dual Degree In addition to your degree at EBS Universität, you can obtain a second international degree (MBA or Master). Extend your studies abroad at one of our partner universities by one semester in the Semester Abroad Track and receive a double degree . This will give you more specialised knowledge in a broader international context and increase your international market value. Challenged-based Learning Experience top-class expert lectures and a strong practical orientation. In addition to interactive lectures, there is an emphasis on case studies and real-world projects, so the degree programme reflects cutting-edge management practices. In addition, close collaboration with industry leaders and practitioners is encouraged to equip students with the skills, competencies and mindsets required in today's global economy. Many possibilities. One language. At EBS Universität you will study at an international level and in an international environment. That's why all lectures and events are, of course, held in English. It could hardly be more international.

raw_evidence_sections.text: Funding This makes the Master in Management special The future cannot be changed with tables, figures and rules alone. The Master in Management provides intensive training in strategic thinking and problem-solving skills – all with a global mindset. You will broaden your horizons and develop your personality. Because only personalities who inspire people to change can make a difference in the world of tomorrow. Knowledge without values has no value. We know just how important it is, especially in business management, to work with diverse stakeholders - meaning empathy and values make the decisive difference. They shape future leaders who drive operations forward and enthrall others. We teach our values of courage, responsibility, consideration and backbone in our courses and in our Coaching & Leadership Hub. Challenge-based learning. Throughout your study programme, the EBS didactic concept of challenge-based learning provides insights into working practice. In close cooperation with partner companies, you learn about the topics that are essential for future leaders, based on real-life cases. In Real Business Challenges, you develop solutions and ideas, which you then present to the Management Board. In this way, you gain an understanding of the challenges of corporate governance. Focus on you: personal development and state-of-the-art knowledge. The trends of technology/digitalization and ESG are an integral part of our programme. In addition, in Professional Development Workshops, you learn important skills that you will later need in practice as a manager. raw_evidence_sections.text: KUKA is a leading global provider of robotics solutions, developing innovative robots and automation technologies for various industries including automotive, aerospace and logistics. With an annual revenue of approximately $3.5 billion US dollars, KUKA continues to push the boundaries of robotics technology and automation systems worldwide. As part of a practical case study, the students worked in small groups to develop future-oriented use cases and customer journeys for the innovative KUKA Cobots. This takes place within a few weeks with the close support of experienced KUKA professionals and iterative coaching sessions with EBS professors and lecturers. The students presented their results to the practice partners and then received qualified feedback on their proposed solutions. The winning team visited KUKA on-site in Augsburg. PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is a renowned global consulting and auditing firm, assisting companies in areas such as tax advisory, auditing, management consulting and technology to achieve their business objectives and tackle challenges. With an annual revenue exceeding $42 billion US dollars, PwC is recognised for its expertise in providing comprehensive business solutions and strategic guidance to clients across diverse sectors. PwC is a popular employer for EBS graduates, and the practical project enables students to gain an early insight into the company and establish potential contacts.
